title: Prospect Ladder: Model-Supply Field Probe + Operational Signal Ladder
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem: Sales and SRE teams need a prioritized, empirically-validated list of model suppliers and variants that can act as practical fallbacks for customer workloads. Existing watchlists are rich in signals but lack an operational prioritization that ties buyer pain (latency + cost + feature gaps) to a short probe plan that the field team can run in <2 weeks.

Goal: Produce an operational 'Prospect Ladder' that: 1) ranks candidate model suppliers/variants by substitution likelihood and operational effort; 2) defines a short field probe plan to collect usage traces, latency/cost deltas, and integration friction; 3) yields a dashboard and a small alert set that surfaces high-risk supplier movement and immediate fallback candidates.

Scope: Market research + PM-run field probes + lightweight engineering harness for 3 prioritized buyer archetypes (Small SaaS, Mid-market PLG app, Regulated-enterprise RAG). Focus on inference surface areas: chat/completion, embeddings, and short-context retrieval augmented generation.

Out of scope: Full procurement, custom legal review, enterprise POC provisioning. This ticket produces the evidence and trigger recommendations to kick off those downstream tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Prospect Ladder spreadsheet with top 25 candidate model+variant rows and scored columns (latency delta, token-cost delta, API compatibility friction, license/redflags)
Field probe playbook with 3 probe scripts, data collection schema, and consent/checklist for customers or replicable synthetic workloads
Dashboard prototype (Looker/Grafana link) that shows probe results and a substitution-readiness score per candidate
Runbook that lists automated alerts (thresholds & slack webhook) and a one-page decision canvas for Sales/CS triggers
dependencies: PM-314159 (field instrumentation task, synthetic workload harness)
